name: Set-System Direct Phrasing
description: Replaced the power-of-2 resonance sums with the direct requirement that the chosen configurations must cover exactly k distinct values for each parameter. This removes the arithmetic that models parse as a bitmask hint, forcing them to recognize the exact cover structure purely from the set semantics, while avoiding the mathematically flawed "sum = k(k+1)/2" suggestion that would have changed the problem's valid outputs.
